test_JSONField_roundtrip: run the FFCV JSONField round-trip test that writes and loads JSON dicts via DatasetWriter and Loader
create_DummyDictDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that returns random index and JSON dictionary pairs for each sample
generate_random_string: generate a random alphanumeric string with a length between a given low and high bound
run_FFCV_JSONField_test: run a test that writes a dataset with IntField and JSONField columns then validates loaded data
unpack_JSONField_batch: unpack a batch of JSON-encoded bytes from FFCV Loader using JSONField.unpack to recover original dicts
